chunk-001:c006.proposition: Origin-of-life research has produced multiple viable prebiotic routes to relevant biomolecules and polymers, while systems chemistry supplies pathways toward protocells.

orphanFallback.rationale: The cited progress in molecular synthesis, polymer formation, and systems chemistry independently supports substantive present knowledge even without a retained opposing move.

chunk-001:c007.proposition: Textbooks address biomolecular synthesis, ribozymes, and autocatalysis, and thousands of scientists work on origin-of-life questions, contrary to portrayals of a simplistic and marginal field.

orphanFallback.rationale: The breadth of textbook subject matter and the asserted size of the research community independently establish that the field contains substantial organized inquiry.

chunk-001:c009.proposition: The carbon-13 NMR sample was ribose-borate with broadened peaks from interconverting forms, while the apparent multitude of compounds was amplified noise rather than evidence against ribose.

orphanFallback.rationale: The distinction between ribose-borate peak broadening and expanded-axis noise independently supplies a technical interpretation of the reported spectrum.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-03.proposition: RNA containing mixed two-prime–five-prime and three-prime–five-prime linkages can retain catalytic behavior, so perfect linkage selectivity is not required for functional prebiotic RNA.

orphanFallback.rationale: The reported catalytic behavior of mixed-linkage RNA independently establishes functional tolerance relevant to plausible early informational polymers.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-05.proposition: Experiments support routes to peptides and nucleotides, RNA polymerization and protection on minerals, and biopolymer encapsulation under prebiotic analog conditions such as wet-dry cycles and hot springs.

orphanFallback.rationale: The surveyed synthesis, mineral-surface, environmental-cycling, and encapsulation results independently form a positive evidentiary case for connectable prebiotic chemistry.

chunk-003:c003-01.proposition: Stochastic crystallization, co-crystallization, deracemization, and polymer-level processes provide multiple experimentally studied routes by which prebiotic homochirality could arise.

orphanFallback.rationale: The existence of several studied enrichment mechanisms independently shows that homochirality is approached through concrete chemical pathways rather than an absence of hypotheses.

chunk-003:c003-05.proposition: Catalytic and self-replicating RNA can form cooperative networks, undergo natural selection, and become enclosed with other molecules in vesicles, supplying a gradual pathway toward protocells.

orphanFallback.rationale: Experimentally studied ribozyme replication, cooperative networks, selection, and vesicle enclosure independently articulate a gradual systems-level route toward protocells.

chunk-003:c003-10.proposition: Gerald Joyce demonstrated a fully self-replicating ribozyme in 2002, providing an experimental instance of RNA-based self-replication.

orphanFallback.rationale: The identified experimental demonstration independently supports the proposition that ribozyme research has achieved chemically realized RNA self-replication.

chunk-004:chunk004-candidate-05.proposition: Mineral surfaces can stabilize RNA and prevent degradation, providing a researched environmental mechanism that mitigates limits from short polymer lifetimes.

orphanFallback.rationale: Mineral-mediated stabilization independently identifies a concrete environmental process by which prebiotic RNA could persist despite degradation pressures.

chunk-004:chunk004-candidate-09.proposition: Plausible routes to important biomolecules, replicator research, and developing systems chemistry make origin-of-life science far from clueless even without a unique reconstruction of life's historical origin.

orphanFallback.rationale: The synthesis of biomolecule pathways, replicator research, and systems chemistry independently supports distinguishing incomplete historical knowledge from scientific cluelessness.
